# Short Walks

## Hawthorn Hill, Annahaia; Forest Nature Reserve Woodland Trail (1 mile)

| **Start grid reference** | **End grid reference** | **Terrain** | **Access** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| J042196 | J042196 | Moderately steep in places.  Graded off road path and forest trails. | Access from Slieve Gullion Forest Park. |

#### **Description:**

A woodland walk exploring Slieve Gullion Forest Park, utilising trails on the lower slopes of Slieve Gullion.

The woodland comprises oak, ash, birch, beech, sweet chestnut and horse chestnut in which was once part of the Chambre Demesne. There are magnificent views of the Ring of Gullion mountains including Croslieve, Slievebrack and Mullaghbane Mountains from the path.

The walk starts and finishes in the car park of Slieve Gullion Forest Park and may be subject to diversion and closure from time to time as this is a working forest.

You can download [The Poets Trails and other walks](https://www.ringofgullion.org/Publications/The-Poets-Trails-and-other-walks.aspx) by clicking here.

## Slieve Gullion Red Squirrel Safari

| **Start grid reference** | **End grid reference** | **Terrain** | **Access** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| J 03400 18914 | J 02985 17863 | Forest roads | From Slieve Gullion Courtyard or from The Mountain Road |

#### Description:

A linear walk along the Gunclub Forest Road. Information panels will tell you about the local habitats and feature pictures of wildlife from Slieve Gullion. There are two hides where you can watch out for Red Squirrels at monitored feeding stations. The best time to see squirrels is dawn and dusk.

Check out our [Ring of Gullion and Cooley Red Squirrel Group](https://www.ringofgullion.org/Red-Squirrel-Group.aspx) for more information.
